xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4741: Fly machine advertises private Fly IPs as lan routes ranked before its public route

plan.title: Fly machine advertises private Fly IPs as lan routes ranked before its public route
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A Fly machine's server (run with OVERDECK_PUBLIC_LINK_ONLY=1) advertises its private Fly IPv4 (tcp://172.19.x.y:3011) as a `lan` endpoint in GET /api/environment. Home stores it via mergeAdvertised, and rankRoutes puts `lan` before the `public` pairing route wss://<app>.fly.dev/ws/link?fly-instance=<id>, so every reconnect dials an unreachable address first before falling back to the public route.
narratives.Proposal: In src/lib/anywhere/endpoints.ts discoverEndpoints, extend the existing OVERDECK_ANYWHERE_NO_ADVERTISE early return so OVERDECK_PUBLIC_LINK_ONLY === '1' also returns []. Fly provisioning pins the VM to home's pan version, so every new Fly machine stops advertising; existing links self-heal because mergeAdvertised drops advertised routes absent from the descriptor and link-supervisor applyDescriptor persists that on the next connect. Document the behavior in docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/fly-provider.md and configuration/linked-machines.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Home does not filter advertised routes by the pairing route's kind or its fly-instance parameter.
- The serve command env string in src/lib/anywhere/fly/provision.ts is not changed.
- No change to rankRoutes, classifyHost, mergeAdvertised or isRfc1918IPv4.
- No migration or one-off cleanup of stored routes in machine-links.json.
- No import from src/dashboard/server/ into src/lib/ (publicLinkOnly is not reused or hoisted).
- No handling for Fly machines already running an older pan; they keep advertising until destroyed.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the source: a server with OVERDECK_PUBLIC_LINK_ONLY=1 advertises no endpoints (issue option A), rather than home filtering routes for fly-instance links (option B).
autoDecisions.rationale: The server is the authority on its own reachability and public-link-only mode already means only the public link reaches it; Fly provisioning forces home's exact pan version onto the VM, so the fix reaches every new Fly machine; mergeAdvertised already heals stored links on the next connect, so no migration is needed; and Fly-specific knowledge stays out of the generic route merge.

autoDecisions.summary: Advertise nothing at all (not only drop `lan`) under public-link-only mode.
autoDecisions.rationale: tailnet IP and Tailscale Serve endpoints are equally outside the mode's 'only the public link' contract, a Fly VM has no Tailscale, and the early return also skips the 5 s tailscale probe. It mirrors the existing OVERDECK_ANYWHERE_NO_ADVERTISE switch exactly.

autoDecisions.summary: Read process.env['OVERDECK_PUBLIC_LINK_ONLY'] === '1' inline in endpoints.ts instead of importing publicLinkOnly from the dashboard server.
autoDecisions.rationale: src/lib must not import src/dashboard/server code (layering, lint:circular); the exact '1' comparison matches publicLinkOnly() semantics.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. (1) docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md `### Public-link-only mode`: add that the server advertises no endpoints (discoverEndpoints returns [] as under OVERDECK_ANYWHERE_NO_ADVERTISE=1), so home's link to a Fly machine holds only the public pairing route, and an older link drops its stale advertised routes via mergeAdvertised on the next connect (PAN-4741). (2) Same file, the bullet starting `OVERDECK_ANYWHERE_NO_ADVERTISE=1 makes a dashboard advertise no endpoints`: add that OVERDECK_PUBLIC_LINK_ONLY=1 has the same effect. (3) docs/fly-provider.md paragraph `**Server environment (D-4).**`: add that OVERDECK_PUBLIC_LINK_ONLY=1 also makes the VM advertise no endpoints, so home never dials Fly's private 172.19.x.y addresses (PAN-4741). (4) configuration/linked-machines.mdx `## Fly machines` list step 3: add a sentence that the Fly machine advertises no private addresses, so this machine reaches it only over wss://<app>.fly.dev.
